answer_1.quote: Question Generation (QG) from text aims to automatically construct questions from textual input.

answer_2.quote: For the automatic evaluation, we utlize some widely adopted metrics including BLEU 1-4, METEOR and ROUGE L. Besides, we also compare results in the semantic content level by using a metric named SPICE.

answer_4.quote: To better evaluate the quality of the generated questions, we conduct human evaluation through Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two candidate questions to determine which one is better in terms of fluency, correctness, and informativeness.
